Easter is the most important holiday in [[Lifeism]].

It celebrates three things

ω [[The First Revelation]] which happened across Holy Week

λ [[Space Passover]] inherited from Jewish Passover and Yuri's Night

α [[The Resurrection]] inherited from Christian Easter

In contrast with [[Alolalia]] it's a very technological oriented holiday
